mapper.sql: SELECT Q.QSTN_ANS_SN AS qstnAnsSn, Q.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, Q.QSTN_ANS_SE_CD AS qstnAnsSeCd, Q.QSTN_CN AS qstnCn, Q.ANS_CN AS ansCn, Q.ANSWR_ID AS answrId, Q.TOC_SN AS tocSn, Q.CCRNC_YN AS ccrncYn, Q.WRTR_ID AS wrtrId, Q.WRT_DT AS wrtDt, A.USER_NM AS answrNm, W.USER_NM AS wrtrNm, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm FROM TB_QSTN_ANS Q LEFT JOIN TB_USER A ON A.USER_ID = Q.ANSWR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER W ON W.USER_ID = Q.WRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TOC T ON T.TOC_SN = Q.TOC_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QSTN_ANS (PBANC_SN, QSTN_ANS_SE_CD, QSTN_CN, ANS_CN, ANSWR_ID, TOC_SN, CCRNC_YN, WRTR_ID, WRT_DT) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{qstnAnsSeCd}, #{qstnCn}, #{ansCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{answrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ccrncYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{wrtrId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QSTN_ANS SET QSTN_CN = #{qstnCn}, ANS_CN = #{ansCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ANSWR_ID = #{answrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TOC_SN = #{tocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CCRNC_YN = #{ccrncYn, jdbcType=CHAR} WHERE QSTN_ANS_SN = #{qstnAnsSn}
